name: Audience, seeds, and research direction
intro: Build a useful research brief before expanding a keyword list.

name: Keyword expansion and related language
intro: Generate candidates, then validate relevance and demand separately.

name: Search intent and customer journeys
intro: Keep wording-based interpretations separate from observed search results.

name: Competitors, existing pages, and content gaps
intro: Competitor wording is observable; rankings and traffic require identified data.

name: Clustering, pillar pages, and site architecture
intro: Propose page boundaries around reader tasks, then confirm them with evidence.

name: Volume, difficulty, prioritization, and measurement
intro: Interpret supplied measurements without manufacturing new ones.

name: FAQs, answer structure, and conversational queries
intro: Answer useful questions without claiming guaranteed snippets or AI citations.

name: YouTube and video topic research
intro: Use platform-specific observations instead of substituting Google keyword volume.

name: Local, ecommerce, service, and multilingual research
intro: Respect real products, service areas, and language differences.

name: Agency delivery, maintenance, and quality control
intro: Create auditable deliverables and keep research decisions accountable.
